item_contract.qabc_id: unique QABC-####; primary key, never clone by grade
item_contract.grade_ids: array of original grade routes, exact V369/V370 join
item_contract.canonical_text_option_key_sha: immutable provenance pointer(s) to source, Trainer and effective editorial; preserve source-vs-Trainer differences
item_contract.imported_keys_by_grade: immutable imported answer key; no silent edits
item_contract.historical_hold_flags: semantic/source and strict flags, include exact issue
item_contract.material_variant: true for the four known source-vs-Trainer option variants
item_contract.pointer_class: one of evidence_pointer_class, based on V370 groups
item_contract.prior_analysis_paths: existing exact per-grade V370 report file paths; open before any new search
item_contract.source_packet_tag: orthogonal to pointer_class; 38 previously indexed specific packets, not automatic approval
item_contract.source_object_action_conditions: exact physical or legal object/action/regime/grade and edition; reject generic substitutes
item_contract.source_locator_and_rights: official source authority, stable original locator, version, rights, offline eligibility
item_contract.original_context: one paragraph before + focused original paragraph + one after, or documented unavailable; no invented text
item_contract.option_review: A/B/C positive evidence, counterexamples, exceptions and linguistic traps, plus grade-specific key status
item_contract.review_evidence: reviewer identity/type, dated source reopening, distinct QA vs same-assistant checks
item_contract.gates: source_authenticity, exact_scope, edition_2026, grade_bibliography, surrounding_context, rights, all_options_uniqueness, trainer_source_fidelity, independent_QA, official_key, learner_signoff
item_contract.state: review_state, with per-gate status and reason
item_contract.last_processed_checkpoint: checkpoint and delta reference; repeated unchanged work earns zero progress

priority_policy.logic: Each QABC appears once at earliest matching priority; material variants overlap six strict holds and 136 historical holds; no double counting. Legal-grade cases not inferred from URL presence. Tie-break stable QABC numeric ascending.
priority_policy.pointer_rule: V370 research report paths first. DIRECT_URL_UNREOPENED is a candidate only. REPORT_POINTER_ONLY means no URL-like string, not no prior research. SPECIFIC_SOURCE_PACKET_PRESENT is an additional tag, not an approval.
priority_policy.official_vs_didactic: 415 source-native units and 153 clearly UNOFFICIAL trainer didactic units: audit separately, never claim didactic as official ANRE keys.

micro_batch_policy.increment_371_2: Produce the first five unique highest-priority QABC ledger records using original V369/V370A/V370, then real source work only within bounded next increment.
micro_batch_policy.checkpoint_rule: One commit and readback per increment; update ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md with completed identifiers and next explicit action; never begin next batch in same increment unless separately requested.
micro_batch_policy.anti_loop_rule: Before/after gates by QABC, immutable QABC seen set, exact source locator and hash; repeat with no newly resolved gate = ZERO newly advanced; reopen same case only for changed evidence, corrected interpretation or explicit blocker resolution.
micro_batch_policy.approval_rule: No change to canonical stems/options/keys, HTML, APK, main, PR merge or release. User asked only on source-backed irreducible decisions or canonical bank changes.
micro_batch_policy.preservation_rule: Retain 157 G2 candidates and 11 original Electro orphans quarantined outside the 822 until separately adjudicated.
